evidence_quotes: Valmet will supply two Valmet IQ Quality Control Systems (QCS) to Viet Nam KORO Paper Joint Stock Company for its new tissue production lines TM3 and TM4 in Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam.
The order is included in Valmet’s orders received in the third quarter of 2026.
data.reason: The article reports that Valmet has received an order to supply quality control systems to Viet Nam KORO Paper, which constitutes a genuine company development.
